text: Correction to prior progress: core has OffWindowPolicy.Exclude and FailTrial only; it has no Include behavior. Repaired studio to preserve those two policies, removed the alias factory, and replaced the tautological placement test with CoordinateProvenance-derived states for dropped-initial, outside-screen, Exclude, FailTrial, and InMap. Both outside-window policies and outside-screen are excluded from the map.
